title: Current expansion safe-release evidence
description: Objective: provide the missing daemon-current safe-release authority from which an expansion planning hold can be created without trusting an agent's `DAEMON_VERIFIED` fields. Hard dependency: task-6cbff01023b14b26a78fc5e3eb1dd8a9 must be DONE and must expose its durable attempt/activation/lease/slot/effect/result/reconciliation reader; re-measure it before planning. Deliverable: a focused daemon reader that derives one exact frozen @moe/core ExpansionReleaseEvidence plus ExpansionHandoffBinding only from the selected project's current durable released attempt facts, with typed ABSENT/UNKNOWN refusals. Consumer: the atomic expansion-request task created next, then task-c4171c1cfe854cb78dd233794b342025. NOT in scope: creating a hold or PlanningRun, scheduler admission, approval, graph activation, or accepting release truth from a command payload. Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/work/expansion-release-authority.ts/.js and focused test. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: The production reader selects durable records by project and attempt identity, and returns BOUND only when the attempt is RELEASED for unchanged `WORK_RELEASE_OR_PAUSE`, the lease and provider slot are RELEASED, effects and resources are terminal, the safe boundary is observed, and one exact committed handoff is present.

The BOUND result rebuilds and deeply freezes the complete core `ExpansionReleaseEvidence` and `ExpansionHandoffBinding` from stored facts; request/caller objects can select an attempt but cannot provide, replace, or upgrade any release, truth, terminal-ref, or handoff field.

Missing, foreign-project, stale, active/draining, terminal-incomplete, conflicting, malformed, or unreadable records return typed ABSENT or UNKNOWN with stable exact code and layer and no release evidence.

File-backed SQLite tests use the real durable attempt records from task-6cbff010, close before reopen on Windows, pin exact code/layer and nonzero hostile/race cases, and mutation-check the production currentness and handoff comparisons.
taskRails: Do not plan until task-6cbff010 is DONE and its release/result reader is verified on disk; if it omits a named fact, repair that producer rather than reconstructing authority here.
No caller-supplied `DAEMON_VERIFIED`, release state, terminal proof, or handoff may become authority; missing/unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN.
Use public package roots across package boundaries; exact codes/layers and positive generated counts; target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400.

comments.author: architect-27b64950
comments.content:
RAIL-1 MEASUREMENT, architect-27b64950 at HEAD fa39721. The open question two prior architects left — "does the completed prerequisite retain every named fact?" — is answered: **no, and it never had them.** task-6cbff010 landed attempt dispatch, but the release-evidence facts have no production producer at all.

FIELD BY FIELD across apps/daemon/src, non-test. `ExpansionReleaseEvidence` (packages/core/src/expansion/expansion-planning-hold.ts:27-36) declares 17 fields. Producer hit counts:

ZERO hits — `effectsTerminal`, `leaseState`, `observationRef`, `providerSlotState`, `receiptRef`, `safeBoundaryObserved`, `terminalEffectRefs`, `terminalResourceRefs`. Also `WORK_RELEASE_OR_PAUSE`: zero.

ONE OR TWO HITS, **all inside `*-test-fixtures.ts`** — `strongestReason` and `terminalTarget` at recovery-test-fixtures.ts:107-108; `attemptState` at :123,142; `leaseRef` at bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts:191; `providerSlotRef` at :192; `resourcesTerminalRef` at :200. And all 14 `DAEMON_VERIFIED` hits are in bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts.

That last line is the finding. The only place these facts exist in the daemon is exactly the place this task's own rails forbid drawing authority from: *"Do not reconstruct safe-release authority from caller payload, DAEMON_VERIFIED fields, or fixtures; omitted producer facts require producer repair."*

WHY IT MATTERS RATHER THAN BEING A NAMING ACCIDENT: core's acceptance predicate (expansion-planning-hold.ts:210-213) admits release evidence only when `truthClass === "DAEMON_VERIFIED"` AND `reason === "WORK_RELEASE_OR_PAUSE"` AND `disposition.strongestReason === "WORK_RELEASE_OR_PAUSE"` AND `disposition.terminalTarget === "RELEASED"`. The drain vocabulary exists — packages/runner/src/supervisor/drain-table.ts, with the design-765 note that "only an unchanged strongest WORK_RELEASE_OR_PAUSE result makes the run resumable" — but no daemon path records it durably for an attempt. A reader written today could only satisfy that predicate by inventing the values.

WHAT DOES EXIST, so the repairs compose rather than rebuild: a work-claim lifecycle with RELEASED (work-claim-read-model.ts:15, work-lifecycle.ts:33-35, CONTEXT_LEGAL_STATES incl. DRAINING). That is the CLAIM's release, not the attempt-plus-lease-plus-slot-plus-terminality bundle the evidence needs.

FILED, three producer repairs:
1. **task-740924b741754955b94a7ccf7fc16bb1** — release disposition with lease and provider-slot state (PLANNING). Covers reason, disposition{resumable,strongestReason,terminalTarget}, attemptState, leaseRef/leaseState, providerSlotRef/providerSlotState.
2. **task-6d40078159e84d92b3293d7b366cf727** — terminal effect and resource refs (BACKLOG). Covers effectsTerminal, resourcesTerminal, terminalEffectRefs, terminalResourceRefs. Enumerates terminality from each item's own authority; never decides it.
3. **task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa** — safe-boundary observation (BACKLOG). Covers safeBoundaryObserved, observationRef. **Note `safe_boundary.observe` is ALREADY in the frozen `RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS`**, so unlike the coordination surface this needs no contracts expansion and is not blocked by the M5 closed-union ruling.

ONE FIELD I DID NOT FILE FOR: `receiptRef` (zero producers). task-44d4873e (Durable verification receipt dispatch) is in flight and persists an immutable `EvidenceReceipt` with a read model — that is plausibly its producer. Whoever unblocks this task should re-measure `receiptRef` against 44d4873e's landed surface rather than assuming either way; if it is still absent, it needs a fourth repair.

Re-blocking this task on all three ids. Its rail 1 is doing exactly what it was written to do.

blockedReason: Verify-or-block remeasurement at current HEAD c1ab42b: a BOUND control is impossible from production bytes. Core requires all 17 fields plus `{digest,ref}` handoff. The sole production `recordAttemptRelease` caller passes `effectsTerminal:false`, `resourcesTerminal:false`, `safeBoundaryObserved:false`, `handoff:null`; scheduler rejects the null handoff, so it writes zero release rows. Non-test daemon has zero `observationRef`, `receiptRef`, `terminalEffectRefs`, or `terminalResourceRefs`; resource records explicitly do not decide terminality. Even a direct accepted release row copies activation `attemptState=RUNNING` and provider slot `ACTIVE`; `releaseProviderSlot` has zero daemon callers and is not exported from `@moe/scheduler`. Its scheduler handoff is not core's `{digest,ref}`. A refusal-only reader would be fail-closed but would not deliver DoD 1/2 or the required real BOUND capability; a test-seeded true request would forge caller authority. Existing producer blockers remain ded026d6, 6d400781, af9454f4. Filed corrective chain task-9f51def1 -> task-2db11099 -> task-79f56ad5 for the oversized root surface, public slot transition, and atomic RELEASED attempt/lease/slot row. Replan only after all four direct producer tasks are DONE and the 17-field map is re-probed.
